rows: One row per commitment hash, newest commitment first.

columns.name: program
columns.meaning: The program's ID. anthropic-cvd for every row today.

columns.name: hash
columns.meaning: The SHA-3-512 commitment hash.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: hash_short
columns.meaning: First 12 characters of the hash.

columns.name: committed_at
columns.meaning: The commitment date, from the program's ledger.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: first_seen_by_us
columns.meaning: Our earliest daily capture containing the hash (its ledger.json fetch time). For Jon's manual capture, the end-of-day bound 2026-10-30T23:59:59Z. Backfill copies never count.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: first_seen_basis
columns.meaning: How to read first_seen_by_us, including the earliest independent evidence available when the data was built: the GitHub commit time of that capture, and the Internet Archive receipt for ledger.json when one exists.

columns.name: tier
columns.meaning: discovered, sent, acknowledged_by_maintainer or revealed.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: disclosed, fixed, withdrawn, merged or empty.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: withdrawn
columns.meaning: The program's withdrawn flag (it can differ from status; both are published as found).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: withdrawn_reason
columns.meaning: The program's withdrawal reason, as found (also set on merged entries).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: merged_into
columns.meaning: The revealed finding a merged commitment was folded into, when the program names one. Withheld unless it names a revealed finding.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: model_severity
columns.meaning: The program's model's own severity rating.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: revealed
columns.meaning: True once the program has revealed the finding.
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: finding_id
columns.meaning: The finding ID (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: project
columns.meaning: Project (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: bug_class
columns.meaning: Bug class (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: cve_ids
columns.meaning: CVE IDs (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: ghsa_ids
columns.meaning: GHSA IDs (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: fixed_in_response
columns.meaning: The program's 'fixed in response' flag (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: patched_at
columns.meaning: Patch date from the ledger (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: revealed_at
columns.meaning: Reveal date from the ledger (revealed rows only).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: card_url
columns.meaning: The finding card's address (revealed rows only).

columns.name: hash_check
columns.meaning: R2 result: match, mismatch, preimage_withheld (the program's card says the preimage is withheld), unavailable (no card or preimage could be fetched or read), not_checked (revealed, no card yet) or not_applicable (not revealed). None of these is an error.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: fix_merged
columns.meaning: R4, as in verification.fix_merged (revealed rows); not_applicable otherwise.
columns.label: Independently verified
